main_text.p: tronos; at supremo hoc judi- ce, non sperent, nisi ferale Theta.

Prodi huc primum Pan- tomime, Alegoriae, Similitudinum & Fabularum Genie: judicibus te siste. Quid? In gremio Charitum educatus, inter Parnassi floscculos lascivire solitus, amoenis Rhetorum spatiis inambulare, ludere natus eras, speciose puer: quae te vesana compulit ambitio, munia Ducis, quibus fungendis, par non es, affectare? Viam praeire vis ad Veritatem; Sed quid ad teneros istos pedes, inaccessa Naturae tesqua, spinosa Philosophiae nostrae dumeta? Genius

page.notes: Catchword absent. The running head is set in small capitals. Several words in the text are printed with long s and are given here as plain s. "Genius" at the line end is set right-aligned as a continuation of the preceding word "Ge-nie" broken across the paragraph; read as printed.
